query: What do Google Pixel 3a XL buyers report about SIM activation, unlocking, and compatibility with their carrier?
search_text: What do buyers report about SIM activation, unlocking, and compatibility with their carrier?

rows.text: Don't buy this phone.. The phone is advertised as "unlocked" which means that it may be used with any carrier. When I inserted my SIM card, I received a message stating that SIM card is not supported by Verizon. So phone is not "unlocked" as advertised. Luckily my son was able to unlock the phone. Phone is great it is just not unlocked as advertised.
Scam. It was locked to Sprint. Description states unlocked to carrier.

Phone is not unlocked. Phone is locked to Verizon. I inserted my SIM for Fi, and a message came up saying it's not supported, and to contact Verizon to unlock it. Wasted over an hour with Verizon support and they could not unlock it for me, saying the new policy is that the phone has to be activated on Verizon for more than 60 days before it can be unlocked, completely defeating the purpose of buying an unlocked phone in the first place...

EXCEPTIONAL customer support! (Hybrid IT). Note: This review is SOLELY for the phone and service by Hybrid IT, the seller. (You can pick your seller! Pick wisely!) Unlocking phones is more an art than science, and it's easy to miss something if you don't actually start the activation process with your preferred carrier. Well, that happened with my initial order of the Google Pixel 3A XL. I posted on Hybrid IT's page about it and within 5 minutes, they were on the phone with me. 10 minutes after that, they had verified that the replacement unit they were going to send me would clear activation on my service (they read the IMEI number to me over the phone and I checked), and they sent it FedEx next day. They also paid for the return shipping to their facility which I just sent out about 30 minutes ago. This level of service is OUTSTANDING.
NOT UNLOCKED. Will NOT work with any carrier except Verizon. SCAM SCAM SCAM
Phone is NOT unlocked. Locked to a carrier, false advertisement and a waste of time.

Phone was locked to Tmobile. Purchased this phone back in March 2020 to use with Total Wireless (Verizon based). Phone was listed as unlocked but would not accept sim card from existing phone. I checked a site on line and it did not show the phone as locked. I thought the phone may have been locked to AT&T but after speaking to one of their store employees, he told me they did not sell this model phone but Tmobile did. Contacted Tmobile national support and after installing an app on the phone I was able to obtain an unlock code and use the Verizon based service. The phone was received in great shape and has performed well but I had to spend around 6 hours to get it unlocked. The seller did offer to cover shipping to return the phone but why false advertize your product?
Phone is locked to Verizon. Phone is locked to Verizon. So buyer beware. Had to return as there is no way to unlock a Verizon locked phone.
Verizon Locked.. Locked for Verizon carrier. IMEI starts with 35, which means locked bootloader as well. It's a scam people.
Not Unlocked. I bought the phones because you sell them as unlocked and it is only for T-Mobile

Total scam. Phone not unlocked.. This phone was not unlocked and after calling the phone carrier attached to the phone they said it was possibly stolen from their warehouse. They could not unlock this phone. This seller is a scam.
Locked phone. Phone is locked to carrier and can not be unlocked without the name and account number. Do not buy from this company you will lose your money.
This phone is locked. you cannot use t-mobile sim cards on this device, despite the fact that it advertises that it is unlocked it is simply not the case.
Don't fall for this. It's locked to Verizon it's not unlocked gsm it's a scam. Just look at the other comments you don't know what it's going to be locked to but it's going to be locked

Not unlocked.. Can't believe I bought this without reading the reviews. How can they keep selling this if it's literally not unlocked like the title says. The phone seems in good condition and all. But kind of worthless if you don't use Verizon. I even called Verizon and tried to see if they could unlock it, but they found it was technically already unlocked, but that's clearly not what the phone itself says. They recommended I return it and get my refund, which is what I'm going to do.

It worked for sprint.. The phone is in good condition. Took sprint phone representatives 2 tries before it accepted my sprint sim card. It ended up being that my old sim card was not compatible with these newer phones. I got lucky seeing I had 2 other sim cards, one of which was used for this Pixel 3axl. After that phone worked perfectly. There are slight blemishes on the screen however that's really not my concern as it has nice rich colors. Blues are dark and rich while blacks are really black and not this darken grey. Generic charger and generic type c USB charger. Not sure if this charger is capable of delivering "7 hours of use with only 15 charge time" as stated on the front page, because the charger and USB have no brand markings.
Phone is not unlocked. My phone was not unlocked. I'm having to call T-Mobile to get it unlocked. If they can't unlock it I'm sending it back

Buyer Beware!!!!! 20% to 50% restocking fee if returned!!!!. Perfect condition and really cute but I didn't notice it was locked to Verizon. I could not use. ****Update****Buyer Beware... this listing showed up in a search for unlocked phones so I mistakenly bought it but it was locked to Verizon. I returned it because I was unable to use it and was charged a 20% restocking fee and a charge to mail back. I am fine with the charge to mail back but the restocking fee was ridiculous and not noted when I ordered. I have had to return items before for various reasons and never lost this much money as a result. I am very unhappy with this merchant and do not recommend.

Not an UNLOCKED phone!!!. The phone is locked to the Verizon network! My old phone died with 4 months of service left on my Mint mobile SIM, so four months of prepaid service down the drain. Instead of wasting precious time with Amazon/Verizon customer service, I switched to Visible and got the phone up and running within 15 minutes after receiving the SIM card.

Buyer Beware --- Not Unlocked. Great news --- Phone came in pristine condition. Was extremely amazed. Bad news --- Phone was not an unlocked device. Tied to TMobile. Tried 2 different Simcards, one from ATT and the other from Verizion. Neither would register and phone would give error that cards were not compatible with the device.
